title: AutoE2E: Don't speak - Language free end-to-end autonomy A Real-Time Driving Model for L2++ ADAS and L4 Robotaxis
abstract: arXiv:2611.22374v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AutoE2E is an open-source end-to-end driving model developed by the Autoware Foundation Robotaxi Working Group. It introduces a temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) architecture that combines multi-camera perception, HD-map information and route conditioning to predict future vehicle motion. The evaluated model uses a pretrained camera-BEV backbone, temporal feature fusion and a lightweight recurrent trajectory planner. It contains approximately 79.9 million parameters, of which approximately 1.45 million are trainable in the evaluated configuration. The v1.0 release provides model checkpoints, training and evaluation code, and DataModelConsole, a dashboard for visualizing and inspecting model experiments. On the KITScenes validation benchmark, the fine-tuned checkpoint achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 0.745 m and a final displacement error (FDE) of 2.020 m at a three-second prediction horizon. translated_title: AutoE2E：无需言语——无语言的端到端自动驾驶：面向L2++级高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）与L4级Robotaxi的实时驾驶模型
translated_abstract: AutoE2E是由Autoware基金会Robotaxi工作组开发的开源端到端驾驶模型。它引入了一种时序鸟瞰图（BEV）架构，结合多摄像头感知、高精地图信息和路线条件来预测车辆未来的运动。所评估的模型使用了预训练的摄像头-BEV骨干网络、时序特征融合以及轻量级的循环轨迹规划器。该模型包含约7990万参数，其中在所评估的配置下约145万参数为可训练参数。v1.0版本发布内容包括模型检查点、训练与评估代码，以及DataModelConsole——一个用于可视化和检查模型实验的仪表板。在KITScenes验证基准上，微调后的检查点在三秒预测时间范围内取得了0.745米的平均位移误差（ADE）和2.020米的最终位移误差（FDE）。论文还报告了初步……
tldr: AutoE2E是一个开源的、不依赖语言的端到端自动驾驶模型，采用时序BEV架构融合多摄像头感知与高精地图信息，以仅约145万可训练参数的轻量级设计实现了面向L2++ ADAS和L4 Robotaxi的实时高精度轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: AutoE2E is an open-source, language-free end-to-end driving model with a temporal BEV architecture that fuses multi-camera perception and HD-map information, achieving real-time and accurate trajectory prediction with a lightweight trainable footprint for L2++ ADAS and L4 robotaxis.
